desc:
A slow site with unclear page titles is hard for visitors and search engines to use. Ecom Swift LLC provides WordPress SEO and speed optimization: faster pages, cleaner code and a tidy search setup for the topics you care about.

## What is WordPress SEO and speed optimization?

Speed optimization shortens the time your pages take to appear and respond. It covers image size, caching, unused code and plugin weight. SEO, short for search engine optimization, is the work that helps search engines understand what each page is about, through titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, sitemaps and structured data.

The two belong together. A fast page is more pleasant to use, and a clear page is easier to find.

## Why speed and search setup matter

Visitors on mobile connections wait a few seconds at most. If the page has not appeared, they go back to the results and pick another site. Search engines also pay attention to how pages perform, so a slow site can lose ground to a lighter competitor.

Search setup has its own risks. Duplicate titles, missing descriptions, broken links and no sitemap leave search engines guessing. When they guess wrong, the wrong page shows up for a search, or none does.

## How this work affects visibility and leads

Faster pages keep more visitors on the site long enough to read and act. Clear titles and descriptions help searchers decide to click your result. Good headings and internal links show which page is your main answer for a topic.

We cannot promise a place in the results. Rankings depend on competition, content quality, links from other sites and many other factors. What we can do is remove the technical barriers and give you a clear base to build on.

## What a solid SEO and speed pass includes

- Speed tests before and after, so you can see what changed.
- Images resized, compressed and loaded only when they come into view.
- A caching setup suited to your host and theme.
- Removal of plugins and scripts that add weight without value.
- Page titles and descriptions written for the topics you target.
- One main heading per page, with subheadings that follow a logical order.
- A keyword map that assigns each topic to one page.
- An XML sitemap that is correct and submitted.
- Search Console connected, so you see how Google reads the site.
- Structured data, broken links and redirects handled in larger packages.

## How we do it

We test your most important pages first and note what slows them. We make a full backup, then work through the fixes one by one, testing after each so nothing breaks. Layout issues are caught early because we check the pages on phone and desktop.

On the search side we review what each page is about and write titles and descriptions for the phrases real customers use. Basic covers the home page and a few top pages. Standard goes sitewide and adds a keyword plan and Search Console. Premium adds structured data, a core web vitals pass and a three-month content plan. You receive before and after speed results and a short list of what to publish next.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Name the services and places you want to be found for.
- Use one main topic per page.
- Upload images at the size they are displayed.
- Test the site after every speed change.
- Publish useful pages on a regular basis.

**Avoid:**
- Installing several caching or SEO plugins together.
- Stuffing the same phrase into every sentence.
- Deleting old pages without a redirect.
- Judging results after only a few days.
- Buying links or using shortcuts that search engines penalize.

## Who it is for

Local businesses that want to appear for their service and city can use the search setup and local add-on. Owners with an image-heavy portfolio or blog often gain the most from speed work. Anyone who has never looked at Search Console will find the first review useful.

## How to get started

Send your website address, the topics or services you want to be found for and the places you serve. We never need your password. We work through an administrator or collaborator user in WordPress, and a hosting login is only needed if your host settings must change, shared by invitation. Your own content stays yours, and we only adjust how it is presented to search engines.
